description.value: Pinch of Spice is a South Indian fine dining restaurant in North Delta serving authentic Indian cuisine prepared by professional chefs, with an extensive menu spanning curries, tandoori breads, biryani, seafood, and Indo-Chinese fusion dishes. The restaurant describes a pleasing dining environment drawing customers from across the Lower Mainland, and offers catering and private event bookings.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Indian restaurant at 8653 120 St (Scott Road), Delta, BC V4C 6R4 with phone 604-502-9991 sourced from the contact page. The menu page includes an online cart widget suggesting takeout capability, and the menu has extensive dedicated vegetarian sections. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, leaving all required criteria as null; notably, the website front page contains injected third-party casino advertising, suggesting possible site compromise or low-quality ad scripts.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists '8653 Scott Road' but website contact page shows '8653 120 St, Delta, BC V4C 6R4'. Scott Road and 120 Street are the same road in this area, so likely the same physical location, but street names do not match textually.
Website About Us page states the restaurant is in 'Surrey, BC' while the contact address and OSM both place it in Delta, BC.

Website front page contains injected third-party casino advertising ('xonbet casino delivers next-level fun for Canadian players'), suggesting the site may have been compromised or is running low-quality ad injection scripts.
Website copyright date is 2013, indicating it may not be actively maintained.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: All three required WWC criteria (bike parking or visibility, water refill, washrooms) are unconfirmed from available evidence; a site visit or direct contact is needed to verify basic cycling-friendliness before listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu has dedicated 'VEG APPETIZER' and 'VEG DISHES' sections with 20+ options including Dal Makhni, Palak Paneer, Chana Masala, Malai Kofta, and others. No explicit vegan or gluten-free labeling found
